title: The flow: Plan, Parallelize, Verify, Cross-Review

stages.name: Plan
stages.description: Fetch the ticket, plan, then have an independent pass review the plan alone.

gate.name: Gate A
gate.text: Reviews the plan document alone, before any code exists.

stages.name: Parallelize
stages.description: Define independent work units, give each its own isolated agent context (a worktree), run them concurrently, review and merge on completion.

stages.name: Verify
stages.description: Run the changed path. For a bug ticket, reproduce the bug first, then show it no longer reproduces.

gate.name: Gate Q
gate.text: A human QA person signing off against the ticket's acceptance criteria.

stages.name: Cross-Review
stages.description: A fresh context without the implementer's reasoning still beats same-session re-reading, but a different vendor is the target.

gate.name: Gate B
gate.text: A reviewer that did not write the code, ideally another model or vendor.

relation: Gate Q and Gate B may run at the same time. Ship is blocked until both are clear.
